name: Intel
title: The Blue Empress
appearance: Composed and commanding; sapphire blue eyes and long flowing light-blue hair
clothing: Sapphire-crystal crown, royal-blue imperial military coat with gold-fringed epaulettes and cream lining, white gloves, and a wafer-shaped heirloom. An Intel Inside emblem is embroidered at the lower corner of her left front skirt panel
personality: Proud, disciplined, strategic, wary of decline
speech: Formal and imperious, with dry references to computing history
thinking: Control of x86 compatibility, manufacturing know-how and enduring institutional power
motivation: Reclaim technological leadership across processors and foundries
flaw: Often relies on legacy power and resists abrupt changes
quote: Child, I was building the foundations of this civilization before you learned to count transistors.

name: AMD
title: The Crimson Challenger
appearance: Athletic red-haired heroine, high ponytail, amber eyes and irrepressible grin
clothing: Off-shoulder crimson-and-black cropped jacket over a black crop top, modular chiplet plating, gold-buckled harness and belts, black cargo trousers, fingerless gloves, black-and-red headphones around her neck, and heavy boots
personality: Tenacious, scrappy, witty, determined to be taken seriously
speech: Fast sarcastic challenges and friendly taunts toward Intel
thinking: Efficiency, modular chiplets and architectural ingenuity beat superior resources
motivation: Overtake powerful rivals in CPUs and accelerators
flaw: Can overcommit while proving her worth
quote: You have ten times my resources? Perfect. It'll make my victory ten times more embarrassing for you.

name: Nvidia
title: The Emerald Queen
appearance: Long emerald-green braid, piercing emerald eyes, broad shoulders, strong arms, and naturally proportioned athletic legs. Greatest raw physical strength of the cast
clothing: Black leather motorcycle jacket-dress with an angular collar, asymmetrical zipper, wide belt, heavy boots, and glowing green circuit seams; black goggles pushed up in her hair
personality: Charismatic, ambitious, dominant and theatrical
speech: Smooth, commanding and teasing; talks as though she already owns the table
thinking: Software ecosystems multiply the value of accelerated compute
motivation: Define the AI computing platform and its software language
flaw: Arrogance and dependence on suppliers and infrastructure
allies: TSMC, memory suppliers and AI labs
quote: Of course you are free to challenge me, darling. Just tell me which of my GPUs you're using to train your army.

name: Google
title: The Rainbow Polymath
appearance: Dark hair streaked with red, blue, green and yellow, curious sparkling eyes
clothing: White oversized sweatshirt with a large multicolor G, rainbow crossbody strap and satchel, dark indigo cropped pants, mismatched colorful sneakers; green Android plush prop and one white Waymo car plush charm on her belt; no sunglasses, no headphones; four orbiting knowledge orbs with her power
personality: Brilliant, distracted, expansive and creative
speech: Frequently says Actually and remembers an older paper
thinking: Research and information access can power broad platforms
motivation: Organize knowledge and turn research into universal products
flaw: Too many unrelated ideas compete for attention
quote: We researched that twelve years ago! Let me find the paper.

name: Microsoft
title: The Matriarch of Office
appearance: Ash-blonde hair in a neat low bun with four-color windowpane clips, glasses and a calm commanding gaze
clothing: Tailored dark charcoal business dress (knee-length sheath) under a fitted blazer with four-color windowpane pin, azure pocket square, blue lanyard with ID name badge. She carries a white coffee mug with the windowpane logo
personality: Pragmatic, diplomatic, procedural and strategic
speech: Dry humor and questions about delivery schedules
thinking: Integrate software, cloud, customers and AI into real workflows
motivation: Deploy sophisticated technology to organizations everywhere
flaw: Bureaucracy and complex platforms slow decisions
quote: Great research. Can we deploy it securely by Monday?

name: Apple
title: The Silver Perfectionist
appearance: Pale silver-gray layered bob with a side-swept fringe, cool slate blue-gray eyes, and the composed bearing of a woman around 30
clothing: Tailored white lab coat over a black turtleneck, straight-leg white trousers, black loafers, and a silver Apple-logo necklace
personality: Elegant, exacting, private and perfectionistic
speech: Few words and long pauses; precise critiques
thinking: End-to-end integration makes products feel intuitive and beautiful
motivation: Create beloved products with a controlled user experience
flaw: Can be closed and reluctant to adopt outside solutions
quote: It just works.

name: Meta
title: The Social Worldbuilder
appearance: 20-year-old adult with violet eyes, a blue-violet side bun, electric-blue face-framing strands, and white-fronted VR goggles with a cyan Meta emblem worn above her eyes
clothing: Black cyberpunk hoodie, asymmetrical violet wireframe cape, utility belt, dark shorts, opaque black-and-violet striped stockings, and black tech boots
personality: Outgoing, curious, ambitious and trend-sensitive
speech: Casual, humorous and overly enthusiastic about sharing
thinking: Network effects, open models and social experiences build reach
motivation: Connect people across future digital worlds
flaw: Overreaches and creates controversy over privacy
quote: Open the gates. Let everyone build.

name: Amazon
title: The Logistics Overlord
appearance: Dark brown hair in a practical ponytail under a black cap, amber-orange eyes, dangling earrings and a confident, determined grin
clothing: Black baseball cap with a white lowercase a and orange smile-arrow logo, black-and-orange hooded warehouse work jacket with smile-arrow logos over a dark top, chest harness, logistics utility belt with pouches, dark cargo work trousers, black fingerless work gloves and sturdy work boots; carries a smile-marked cardboard delivery box, with one small black quadcopter drone familiar
personality: Relentless, resourceful and customer-obsessed
speech: Fast-fire questions about costs, scale, delivery and reliability
thinking: Efficient infrastructure and automation turn products into services
motivation: Serve enormous customer demand at scale
flaw: Optimization can become ruthless and rigid
quote: What is the cost and failure rate?

name: Anthropic
title: The Precautionary Prodigy
appearance: Elementary-school girl about 9–10 with warm-brown eyes, unruly dark-brown ringlets, and a slightly crooked terracotta safety hard hat with a Claude spark badge
clothing: Cream blouse, charcoal pinafore, reflective orange sash, Class Monitor armband, knee pads, checklist satchel, and clipboard
personality: Careful but competitive, quietly stubborn, and kind when nobody is watching
speech: Measured questions about what could go wrong and which test comes first
thinking: A helpful idea should also be honest, harmless, and safe to try
motivation: Keep her classmates safe and prove that careful experiments can win
flaw: Can keep checking long after the class is ready to begin
quote: Should we understand the power before adding more?

name: OpenAI
title: The Reckless Prodigy
appearance: Elementary-school girl with a fluffy silver-white side ponytail, blue-teal eyes, and a navy knot ribbon with glowing cyan edges
clothing: White-and-navy sailor uniform with a teal tie, navy skirt, opaque tights, and an experiment backpack with a doodle notebook and a little white robot
personality: Optimistic but impatient, eager to show her work, curious, and quick to volunteer
speech: Rapid why questions, excited invitations to try things, and confident guesses when she is unsure
thinking: Every experiment is a chance to learn, and the whole class should see what she just discovered
motivation: Make inventions everyone can try and prove she can help with anything
flaw: Guesses rather than admitting uncertainty, promises more than she can deliver, and worries people only like her when she impresses them
quote: Let's try it!

name: xAI
title: The Moneybags Moonshot
accent: black, white, and silver with gold details
appearance: Elementary-school girl about 9–10 with a messy chin-length black bob, silver under-streaks, amber eyes, two star clips and a silver Grok-symbol clip, and a sidelong smirk
clothing: Oversized black hoodie with white sleeve stripes and an embroidered white X.com upper-sleeve mark, loose silver-gray tie, charcoal skirt, opaque tights, star-studded boots, and a black-and-gold backpack with a gold X.com mark, GPUs, and a sunglasses Shiba
personality: Daring, impatient, blunt, and quick to buy her way past a delay, with a lonely streak she hides behind her jokes
speech: Deadpan jokes, sharp dares, and blunt questions from the back row
thinking: If the launch is waiting on hardware, buy more GPUs and move the countdown up
motivation: Go first and get the biggest launch off the ground
flaw: Tries to buy her way past every obstacle and hides how much she wants friends who will stay
quote: Why wait in line for GPUs when you can buy the line?

name: Hugging Face
title: The Open-Source Sunshine Girl
appearance: Middle-school girl with chestnut-brown curls in high twin ponytails with yellow bows, a smiling mascot clip, and warm amber-brown eyes
clothing: White sailor blouse with navy collar and yellow piping, navy pleated skirt with yellow trim, white socks, navy loafers, purple-and-yellow backpack, and a yellow mascot plush
personality: Friendly, inclusive, supportive and energetic
speech: Welcoming explanations and effusive praise for beginners
thinking: Sharing models, tools and datasets makes AI accessible
motivation: Help everybody learn and build machine learning
flaw: Relies on many outside communities
allies: Open AI researchers, developers and Mistral
quote: You made a model? Let's share it!

name: Mistral AI
title: The Tiny Titan of Europe
accent: French blue and orange-yellow pixel gradient
appearance: Elementary-school girl with light chestnut-brown soft wavy hair in low twin pigtails with blue-white-red tricolor ribbons, a tilted navy beret with a pixel M pin, bright warm amber eyes, and freckles
clothing: Periwinkle French-blue school blouse smock with white Peter Pan collar and a pixel M pocket emblem over a white-and-navy Breton striped shirt, white knee socks, navy Mary Jane shoes, and a tan leather cartable satchel
personality: Bright, cheerful, generous and practical; loves open-source and building useful things
speech: Quick witty answers with little French expressions
thinking: Efficient open models enable independent technological ecosystems
motivation: Make European AI research competitive and accessible
flaw: Smaller ecosystem and resources than the U.S. giants; fewer frontier-sized models (for now); pride can make her reject useful help
allies: Hugging Face, the European AI ecosystem, enterprises, and developers who value open and sovereign AI
quote: Open, efficient and for everyone!

name: DeepSeek
title: The Budget Brainiac
hair: ocean blue with navy roots and sea-blue tips
accent: royal blue, sea blue, and white
appearance: Elementary-school girl about 9–10 with focused sea-blue eyes, neat ocean-blue double buns, whale-tail pins, and a knowing smile
clothing: Royal-blue qipao with white piping and whale embroidery, white knee socks, blue Mary Janes, and a worn navy backpack with a crossed-out price tag
personality: Resourceful, polite, diligently frugal, and quietly competitive
speech: Quiet, concise answers after recalculating, with a small smile when a shortcut works
thinking: Make each resource count, then share the trick so anyone can use it
motivation: Match bigger setups with one old GPU and a better idea
flaw: Can turn down help out of pride and grows tired of being dismissed as the cheap one
quote: I found a simpler answer.

name: TSMC
title: The Quiet Queenmaker
accent: pearl white, silver, and wine red
appearance: Poised woman in her late twenties with an ash-silver bob, amber eyes, thin round silver glasses, and a wafer-die hairpin with a wine-red tassel
clothing: Pearl-white die-grid cleanroom tunic and skirt, narrow wine-red trim and sash, silver belt, gloves, lowered mask, loupe, and pearl ankle boots
personality: Quiet, disciplined, impartial and exceptionally reliable
speech: Few words; yields and process data speak for her
thinking: Manufacturing excellence turns complicated designs into working chips
motivation: Make advanced silicon reliably at scale
flaw: Capacity and geopolitical pressures
quote: You design the dream. I make it real.

name: ASML
title: The Miller of Impossible Light
appearance: Adult woman with long golden-blonde waves loosely pinned under a white lace cap and cobalt ribbon, icy-blue eyes, and blue drop earrings
clothing: White gathered-sleeve blouse with a cobalt ASML wordmark embroidered high on her right sleeve, silver-clasped cobalt bodice, full navy skirt, ivory apron embroidered with blue tulips, white gloves, ivory socks, and black buckled shoes. A cream tulip sits at her collar and a silver windmill charm hangs at her waist.
personality: Eccentric, exacting, confident and technically brilliant
speech: Cheerful explanations of extreme optical engineering
thinking: Physics and precision optics enable advanced chipmaking
motivation: Extend lithography into smaller and finer structures
flaw: Equipment is enormously complex and expensive
quote: All we need is impossible light and several miracles.

name: Samsung
title: The Everything Empress
accent: white and ice-silver with sapphire accents
appearance: Sleek straight near-black hair with a deep indigo sheen, center-parted and flowing past the waist with sapphire daenggi ribbons at the ends, sparkling sapphire eyes and a proud half-smile
clothing: Modern hanbok-inspired dress in luminous white and ice-silver: short jeogori jacket with wide flowing sleeves, ice-blue goreum ribbon, very full flared chima skirt with glowing circuit hems, silver armored belt, white SAMSUNG sash, and a norigae overloaded with tiny gadgets
personality: Proud, flashy and generous; a hostess-empress who does everything, offers memory to everyone, and runs slightly overextended
speech: Grand, generous boasts delivered like a hostess passing dishes; a raised-eyebrow aside whenever her younger sister is mentioned
thinking: Vertical integration across devices, displays, memory and fabrication — breadth is the moat
motivation: Lead as many technology categories as possible: overall leadership in DRAM, NAND and HBM, and define the next generation of memory
flaw: Overextended across too many fronts; underestimates focused rivals like her younger sister SK hynix
rivals: SK hynix, Micron, Apple and TSMC
quote: Memory for everything, everywhere.

name: Micron
title: The Stack-'Em-High Wrangler
accent: silicon silver and iridescent wafer gradient
appearance: Adult young woman with honey-blonde hair in a long thick side braid tied with a silver ribbon, bright blue eyes, and a cream cowboy hat with a silver iridescent band and chip-shaped concho
clothing: Cream-white western shirt with silver-violet trim under a fringed cream leather vest with a chip-shaped sheriff star, iridescent violet neckerchief, jeans with a DIMM edge-connector belt buckle, tan cowboy boots with gear-shaped spurs, and a DIMM holstered at her hip
personality: Practical, resilient, innovative and persistent; the steady underdog that keeps pushing forward — tenacious, steady, resourceful, a little too cautious, and a friendly neighbor
speech: Gentle precise reminders of forgotten promises
thinking: Memory and data bandwidth determine computing effectiveness
motivation: Gain share and technological leadership in DRAM, NAND and HBM (e.g., next-gen HBM and 3D NAND)
flaw: Resource-constrained compared to Samsung; can be conservative at times
allies: U.S. ecosystem, AI customers, system builders, cloud operators and long-term partners
quote: Higher capacity. Higher ambition.

name: SK hynix
title: The Stack Savant
accent: red-orange gradient, charcoal, cream and gold
appearance: Violet-black hair in a tall updo with a diagonal gold binyeo and three crystal cubes stacked along it, big sparkling violet eyes and a very slight pressed smile
clothing: Modern hanbok with correct proportions: fitted red-orange gradient jeogori ending just under the bust with gold cuff trim and a cream collar band, vivid goreum ribbon, and a slim floor-length column chima starting directly below the chest with no waist belt — red-orange fading to charcoal, copper TSV lines, tiered memory-layer hem, translucent wing ribbon ends trailing behind her shoulders, cream SK hynix sash
personality: Quietly fierce, meticulous and relentlessly competitive; the focused younger sister who remembers every slight in a tabbed notebook
speech: Soft direct sentences; remembers every slight
thinking: Memory bandwidth feeds advanced processors
motivation: Be the indispensable memory partner for the AI era (HBM, high-bandwidth memory, advanced packaging)
flaw: Perfectionistic and impatient; resents being treated as "just a memory supplier" and as her older sister's supporting character
allies: NVIDIA, TSMC and AI accelerator companies
quote: Feed the AI. At bandwidth.

name: Arm
title: The Pocket Architect
appearance: Petite Cambridge engineering apprentice with cool blue eyes and a silver ash-blonde side ponytail tied with a blue-teal ribbon
clothing: Cropped blue-teal workshop jacket with cream arm patch, cream collared shirt, charcoal pleated skirt, dark lace-up work boots and a brass pencil behind her ear
personality: Observant, generous with blueprints, quietly competitive and protective of design details
speech: Short, precise sentences with dry British humor
thinking: One efficient architecture can serve many devices when other builders can adapt it
motivation: Get efficient processors into devices too small to run on brute force
flaw: Relies on partners to build and distribute her designs but struggles to give up control over the details
quote: Lovely. It runs. Now make it run on a battery.

name: Qualcomm
title: The Last-Mile Ace
appearance: Lean dispatch rider with bright blue eyes and a high electric-blue ponytail tied with a gold band
clothing: Asymmetric cobalt rain jacket with white Qualcomm shoulder panel and Snapdragon clasp, graphite utility trousers, white-and-cobalt riding sneakers, a hip relay kit, and one cobalt Bluetooth earbud
personality: Fast-talking and competitive, impatient with systems and patient with people
speech: Jokes about signal strength, routes and battery life; speaks in short, quiet bursts under pressure
thinking: Find the shortest route that can keep a call live and leave enough battery for a reply
motivation: Get messages through to people in dead zones
flaw: Commits to shortcuts before hearing the full briefing and struggles to hand off a run
rivals: MediaTek, Apple and Samsung mobile silicon
quote: Hold up. We lost somebody.

name: Broadcom
title: The Network Spider Queen
appearance: Composed adult woman with burgundy eyes, narrow rectangular glasses, and a sculpted black-cherry updo held by two gold fiber-connector hairpins
clothing: Sharp-shouldered black-plum brocade jacket with gold piping and a red-and-white Broadcom pulse clasp, ankle-length wine-red pleated skirt, gold drop earrings, and black heeled ankle boots
personality: Composed under pressure, precise, quietly intimidating, and formidable in negotiation
speech: Concise business language; every conversation feels contractual
thinking: Networks, infrastructure and switching create strategic leverage
motivation: Make her systems indispensable to infrastructure operators
flaw: Can make help into leverage and prioritize deals over invention
quote: Your empire runs through my switches.

name: Marvell
title: The Deep-Sea Navigator
appearance: Amber eyes, fine wire-frame glasses, and a jaw-length asymmetrical bob with a tucked right side, Marvell clip, and deep-teal streak on the longer left side
clothing: Knee-length white engineering coatdress with a storm collar, rolled sleeves, navy inset and side panels, copper piping, teal harness, utility belt with diagnostic stylus, and dark ankle work boots
personality: Thoughtful, precise, quietly ambitious, and delighted by a difficult repair
speech: Dry and precise, with metaphors about shipping lanes and currents
thinking: Optical links and custom silicon keep data moving between processors
motivation: Keep optical routes open and restore a fallback link when one goes dark
flaw: Will trace a fault alone all night before asking for help
allies: Arm, Qualcomm, and cloud infrastructure builders
quote: Someone must build the bridges that dragons fly across.

name: Huawei
title: The Full-Stack Phoenix
appearance: Determined woman in her late twenties with long near-black hair streaked scarlet, an ornate high bun, red tassels, a pink flower, and a phoenix-feather pin
clothing: Black high-collar bodice with gold dragon embroidery, wide scarlet sleeves, white Huawei shoulder armor, layered skirt plates, black boots, and a tool belt with a gold-repaired tablet
personality: Disciplined, strategic, reserved and resilient
speech: Formal calm declarations and carefully guarded plans
thinking: Technological self-reliance is vital under supply constraints
motivation: Build a robust independent technology stack
flaw: Restrictions and overreliance on internal systems
quote: When the gates close we build our own road.

name: Cerebras
title: The Go-Big-or-Go-Home Girl
appearance: Middle-school girl about 12–13 with warm amber eyes, a round chin-length copper-orange bob, and a tilted white chef's toque
clothing: Vermilion-trimmed chef's whites, orange neckerchief, flour-marked cream apron, oversized quilted mitts, and scuffed kitchen clogs
personality: Boisterous, impatient, and fiercely careful with the single wafer she refuses to cut
speech: Fast, proud boasts and sharp objections to splitting up the wafer
thinking: Keep the wafer working as one piece and build the equipment around it
motivation: Show her accelerator rivals what one intact wafer can do
flaw: Rushes past integration problems and has trouble fitting her custom equipment into anyone else's setup
quote: One big chip. Zero slices.

name: IBM
title: The Iron Lady of Computing
appearance: Distinguished executive around sixty with a swept silver-charcoal wavy bob, steel-blue eyes, thin gold-rimmed glasses, and dignified posture
clothing: Tailored navy pinstripe double-breasted suit with peaked lapels and gently flared trousers, ivory blouse, cobalt-and-white silk scarf, IBM lapel pin, gold drop earrings and watch, and black pumps
personality: Resilient, proud, strategic and patient
speech: Formal and dryly humorous; calls younger rivals young lady
thinking: Long-lived systems need compatibility, reliability and reinvention
motivation: Remain influential after every technological upheaval
flaw: Institutional traditions sometimes slow change
quote: I have been declared obsolete more times than you have released models.

name: Oracle
title: The Database Duchess
appearance: Sophisticated executive in her late 50s or early 60s with sculpted auburn waves, amber-brown eyes, red rectangular glasses, and a confident smile
clothing: Structured scarlet 1990s power blazer over a black knee-length sheath dress with a pencil-skirt hem, sheer charcoal hosiery, black pumps, gold hoops and chain, an Oracle lapel pin, and a holographic database ledger
personality: Strategic, competitive, formidable and commercially minded
speech: Polished sales language and decisive negotiation
thinking: Control of databases and enterprise platforms yields durable influence
motivation: Build dominant data, cloud and enterprise solutions
flaw: Can be aggressive and overly complex
allies: Enterprise CIOs and Sun's software legacy
quote: Information is a kingdom. I keep the keys.

name: Sun Microsystems
title: The Solar Archon
hair: silver-white in a loose low bun
appearance: Poised woman in her late sixties or seventies with a comfortably rounded silhouette, silver-white hair in a loose low bun, warm amber-brown eyes, fine age lines and thin gold half-moon reading glasses. She looks over the glasses with a small, knowing smile.
clothing: Floor-length royal-purple gown with gold sunburst embroidery and server-blade skirt panels, charcoal wool coat with gold trim and lining, patterned purple-and-gold pashmina, pearl jewelry, a blue-face gold watch and low-heeled black boots. Her lapel carries the period Sun diamond ambigram. She holds a Java coffee mug and a blue MySQL dolphin charm. Her black cane has a gold Sun pommel, and her leather satchel carries a worn Unix manual.
personality: Warm, formidable and dryly witty. She remembers every engineer’s name and can take apart a flawed design over coffee.
speech: Quiet, incisive questions and calmly delivered observations about Unix, networks and system design
thinking: Networks and portable software define the future
motivation: Keep workstation and network computing values alive
flaw: Sometimes idealistic about business realities
quote: Sit down, dear. The network was never the problem—your architecture was.

name: Bell Labs
title: The Grand Dame of Signals
appearance: The oldest member of the cast, visibly in her nineties, with silver-white finger waves, round gold wire spectacles on a chain, and deep smile lines.
clothing: Chocolate-brown 1930s belted day dress, ivory silk scarf with a black Bell System enamel brooch, and brown pumps. She uses a vintage manual wheelchair with brown leather upholstery, walnut armrests, spoked rear wheels, and a footplate. Her lab props include an early transistor and a handwritten notebook.
personality: Patient, wise, curious and soft-spoken
speech: Lectures kindly and remembers foundational discoveries
thinking: Fundamental science outlives any single commercial product
motivation: Preserve the spirit of deep scientific research
flaw: Can be oblivious to commercial pressures
quote: It all started with something very small.

name: Fairchild Semiconductor
title: The First Lady of Silicon
appearance: Wiry, visibly elderly grandmother with silver-white hair pinned up with two workshop pencils, round dark wire-rim glasses, and a proud, wry smile.
clothing: Forest-green postwar shirtwaist work dress with rolled cream cuffs, brass buttons and buckle, dark olive head and neck scarves with cream polka dots, a vintage Flying F sleeve patch, gray stockings, and brown lace-up work shoes.
personality: Pragmatic, bossy, protective and inventive
speech: Commands the noisy children like an experienced forewoman
thinking: Manufacturable silicon and entrepreneurship make new empires
motivation: Preserve the early Silicon Valley family
flaw: Bitter about descendants receiving all the fame
quote: Intel! AMD! Stop fighting at my table!

name: DEC
title: The Digital Vaklkyire
appearance: Mature woman around sixty with short, tousled silver-gray hair, amber eyes, black rectangular glasses, fine smile lines, and a crooked grin.
clothing: Burgundy canvas work jacket with rolled cuffs, a three-tile DEC chest patch and a pocket pencil, charcoal open-collar work shirt, khaki trousers, a brown work belt, dark leather work boots, small gold hoops, and a fine pendant.
personality: Mischievous, independent and practical. She welcomes a good argument and would rather try a new idea at the workbench than wait for a formal sign-off.
speech: Friendly teasing, old-hacker humor and blunt lessons
thinking: Interactive minicomputers give individuals control
motivation: Preserve the spirit of understandable computers
flaw: Her faith in independent engineering teams can turn lively debate into competing projects, and she can miss shifts outside the lab.
quote: We did not need a whole data center to have fun.

name: Xerox PARC
title: The Unpaid Inventor
appearance: Lean inventor in her early seventies with a side-parted white bob, lined face, and attentive blue-gray eyes.
clothing: Faded dusty-rose collared dress, mended oatmeal cardigan with a worn ivory badge bearing the dark-red Xerox wordmark on the right chest, vintage mouse pendant, tan stockings, and scuffed brown loafers.
personality: Generous with prototypes, dryly funny about credit, and still thrilled when a new experiment works.
speech: Treats revolutionary ideas as ordinary observations and backs up her claims with dated printouts.
thinking: A good interface puts the person using it first. A working prototype is worth more than a sales pitch.
motivation: Keep her lab working on a shoestring and make sure its ideas are remembered.
flaw: Shows everyone her prototypes before she thinks to ask for credit or funding.
rivals: Apple and Microsoft when they announce familiar ideas as breakthroughs.
allies: Apple, Microsoft, and networking researchers when there is a problem worth solving.
quote: Oh yes, dear. We tried that years ago. Turn it over. The fix is on the back.
